dedupe_keys.name: frequentation du pole de la defense experimentation de lissage des heures de pointe

description: Fréquentation du Pôle de La Défense (expérimentation de lissage des heures de pointe) is a dataset listed in Île-de-France Mobilités open data, an open data portal of a public transport authority, published or maintained by Île-de-France Mobilités. Ces données sont issues de 14 capteurs de comptage, placés au niveau des points d’accès aux stations de La Défense (Grande Arche) et Esplanade de La Défense. Coverage: France (network area of the operator or portal owner). The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Fréquentation & Statistiques. Its keywords are Fréquentation, Chercheur ou journaliste. The portal shows 2023-11-21 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-idfm-open-data-portal.
